title: Reproducible Source-Identity Correspondence
objective: Compare block-pinned deployed bytecode evidence with declared local build artifacts and assign source-identity correspondence states only when recorded compiler settings and bytecode comparison support them.
excluded_scope: Token, liquidity, minting, or asset actions

state_definitions.MATCHED: The normalized deployed runtime bytecode matches a declared local build artifact produced with recorded compiler settings.
state_definitions.PARTIAL: A deployed code observation exists, but a declared artifact or reproducible bytecode comparison is incomplete or mismatched.
state_definitions.UNKNOWN: Insufficient declared artifact or deployed evidence exists to evaluate source identity.
